gaps.userNeed: I need full agency and non-destructive state control over my posts so I can experiment with visual changes without fearing permanent loss of my original layout.
gaps.explanation: Users editing on mobile experience psychological friction when changes auto-commit instantly without safety nets. This isn't just a request for a shortcut button, but a fundamental need for peace of mind and full state revision management while drafting content on touchscreen devices.
gaps.confidenceJustification: High confidence based on detailed low-rated feedback highlighting anxiety around instant auto-saving combined with inadequate undo mechanisms, unsupported by current closed visual-confirmation issue #21189.
gaps.verdictReason: GitHub issue #21189 was closed around visual confirmation of blog restoration, completely missing the underlying core need for explicit post draft versioning and granular undo controls while writing.

gaps.rankingReasoning: Ranked #1 due to direct collision with post publishing core workflows, supported by high-friction 2-star feedback and insufficient closed issue scope on GitHub.
gaps.counterArgument: The review rev-31a0c4de merely expresses frustration over basic text-editing controls like a visible Undo button and explicit save options, rather than a deep latent need for complex non-destructive revision management. Furthermore, issue #21189 explicitly shows that an UNDO functionality already exists in the app, meaning the core capability is present and the issue is simply a lack of visual confirmation feedback. Elevating a straightforward UI polish bug into a fundamental psychological gap overstates both the severity and the actual scope of user complaint.
